_comment: Voice catalog for TTS. Adding a voice = edit this file (no code change).
Discover IDs with: py -m scripts.ops voices
elevenlabs.<category>[] -> paid ElevenLabs voices. Categories are cosmetic:
a channel with no tts.voice_pool draws from ALL categories, weighted.
local.piper[]  -> path to a voice .onnx (needs its .onnx.json beside it)
local.kokoro[] -> a built-in Kokoro voice name (e.g. af_heart)
local.xtts[]   -> path to a speaker reference .wav (XTTS voice clone)
local.qwen[]   -> a built-in Qwen3-TTS speaker name, OR a reference .wav to CLONE
(transcript from a sidecar <ref>.txt or QWEN_REF_TEXT). Needs a GPU.
weight = relative odds when a voice is picked at random (higher = more often).
Fill in blank 'name'/'notes' from `ops voices` output, then re-categorize.
A category whose name starts with '_' is PARKED: kept for reference, never used.
_parked_voice_not_found holds ids the API rejects with 400 voice_not_found - they
are not in this account's library. Add them from the ElevenLabs Voice Library
(Voices -> Explore -> Add to my voices), re-run `ops voices` to confirm they list,
then move them into a real category above.
